reviewerAccess: No app login. Library/settings and saved backup inspection work without hardware. MIDI/ROM operations require a compatible FM-1, data-capable Android 14+ host and stable power. Newly enabled ROM writes still require physical acceptance testing.

localOnly: instrument UUIDs, names/colors, observed USB serials and last firmware identity
job target/package hashes, outcomes and bounded stage history
bounded local operation log: 256 KiB per day, 10 MiB total, configurable 7/14/30-day retention; session-only package Undo
full ROM/MBOOT backups, imported backups, flash UID/chip metadata and local operation results
source credentials, OAuth tokens and pending callbacks encrypted using Android Keystore
externalServers: enabled catalog origins (Firmware Hub by default; Awesome FM-1/custom sources opt-in)
GitHub API/download hosts and approved firmware-author URLs
automaticallyRequestedOnline: enabled catalogs subject to persisted source intervals
permitted preview images for displayed entries
optional background checks of enabled catalogs, disabled by default
userInitiatedRequests: explicit source checks, including a disabled source, subject to its interval
firmware release metadata and package downloads
dataInventory.deletion: Clear Android app data or uninstall. Individual package removal is available inside the app. There is no app account.
dataInventory.dataSafetyForm: Review third-party operators' actual collection and retention before final answers. Do not equate absence of publisher telemetry with absence of data received by external servers.
dataInventory.buildScope: 0.10.1: debug uses test Firebase, Play uses production Firebase, F-Droid has no analytics SDK. Production store declarations must match the actual signed AAB.

requiredManualChoices: foreground-service declaration and requested physical-device video
status: 0.10.1 release inventory; submission/approval status is determined in Play Console.
publishingBlocker: Store/account prerequisites and declarations must be verified; CI alone does not establish physical acceptance or Play approval.
